notes.en:
Herdline 0.6.87 (Experimental)

- Sending an image from the composer now clears the draft once OMP has received it. Previously, OMP's leading [Image #N, WxH] marker made Herdline treat the turn as not landed and keep the draft.
- Notifications use one fixed neutral Mono app identity on every launcher icon choice. Notifications no longer carry a large icon. Your launcher icon choice is unchanged. Status glyphs and privacy are unchanged.

Known issue: after upgrading from an earlier version, the notification card may keep showing the previous app icon. The cause is not yet confirmed; it is under investigation. A fresh install shows the Mono icon.

Verification: focused emulator QA (Android 17, API 37):
- the 0.6.87 (10132) image-send cleanup passed;
- on 10133, a fresh-install notification shows the Mono icon, with no large icon on any notification;
- the notification icon does not change with the selected launcher icon (Dusk checked).
This is not a full or physical-phone QA pass. Samsung devices and the Done notification were not tested. The signed release runtime was not separately tested.
